module: Powertrain component `frictionClutch`: friction clutch placed right after an engine (the parent must be of category `engine`). It models a locking spring on a clutch angle, damping, free play, wear/damage and a thermal model (temperature, efficiency, smoke, messages to the player, permanent damage). The clutch ratio comes from `electrics.values.clutchRatio` (1 = engaged, 0 = disengaged). A modder sets its parameters in the jbeam or reads its temperature.
usage:
local clutch = powertrain.getDevice("clutch")
print(clutch.clutchTemperature, clutch.thermalEfficiency) -- °C, 0.5..1 (0.25 if destroyed)
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, additionalEngineInertia (kg·m², default 0), electricsClutchRatioName (default 'clutchRatio'), lockDampRatio (default 0.15, 1 = critical damping), lockDampSmoothing (0), clutchAngleSmoothing (0), clutchStiffness (1), clutchFreePlay (rad, 0.125), lockSpringCoef (1), lockTorque (N·m, otherwise computed in validate), lockSpring (N·m/rad, otherwise computed), thermalsEnabled (true), coolingCoef (1), maxClutchTemp (°C, 500, permanent damage), warningTemp (200), maxSafeClutchTemp (300), clutchOverheatRange (100), clutchMass (kg, 10), clutchSpecificHeat (J/kg/K, 490).

Main fields: inputAV (rad/s, = parent.outputAV1), outputAV1 (rad/s, set by the child/the powertrain), outputTorque1 (N·m, transmitted torque = torqueDiff), torqueDiff, clutchAngle (rad), clutchRatio, lockTorque (N·m max transmissible), lockSpring, lockDamp, maxClutchAngle, thermalEfficiency (0.5 to 1, 0.25 if clutchPermanentlyDamaged), clutchTemperature (°C), clutchPermanentlyDamaged, cumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio (gearRatio fixed at 1).
The transmitted torque is limited to ± lockTorque * thermalEfficiency * damageLockTorqueCoef * wearLockTorqueCoef. The spring is quadratic up to 1 rad then linear.
The injected heat is frictionLossPerUpdate = sum of torqueDiff * (inputAV - outputAV1) * dt (joules); it is reset to 0 in updateGFX. setLock(true) cuts this input (clutchThermalsCoef = 0).

updateGFX sends the GUI stream 'clutchThermalData' if the stream is requested, shows messages 'High clutch temperature...', 'Clutch overheating...', 'Clutch permanently damaged!' and triggers damageTracker.setDamage('powertrain', name, true).
Minor bug: if child 1 does not exist, updateGFX indexes device.children[1].transmissionNodeID without checking when the smoke timer reaches 1 (potential error if device.children is empty).

requiredExternalInertiaOutputs.desc: {1}: port 1 receives its inertia from outside (the powertrain handles the inertia on the output side).

new.desc: Builds the frictionClutch device: wear/damage coefficients, smoothings, thermal parameters (warning, safe and destruction temperatures, mass and specific heat) and selects velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate.

updateGFX.desc: Non-physics update (once per frame): clutch heating and cooling, thermal efficiency, smoke, warning messages, permanent damage, sending of the GUI stream 'clutchThermalData'. Resets frictionLossPerUpdate to 0.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: inputAV = parent.outputAV1.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: integrates the clutch angle according to the speed difference, applies free play and spring/damping, clamps by lockTorque, writes outputTorque1 and accumulates the friction loss.

setLock.desc: Enables or not the thermal "lock": if enabled is true, the clutch no longer heats up (clutchThermalsCoef = 0), otherwise it heats normally.

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases the free play (damageClutchFreePlayCoef) and reduces the lock torque (min 0.2) according to the damage, then recomputes the inertia.

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (according to the odometer) and damage (according to the integrity: number 0..1 or table) then recomputes the inertia. Also restores clutchPermanentlyDamaged.

odometer.desc: Distance traveled in meters (wear from 30000 km to 500000 km).

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity 0..1 (minimum of free play and lock torque, 0 if destroyed) and the corresponding state table.

validate.desc: Checks that the parent is an engine (deviceCategories.engine), otherwise logs errors and returns false. Computes the default lockTorque = 1.25 * max engine torque + engine inertia * max speed (rad/s).

returns.desc: false if the parent is not an engine.

calculateInertia.desc: Takes the inertia and cumulative ratios of the first child, caps the inertia at half of the engine's, and computes lockSpring, lockDamp and maxClutchAngle.

reset.desc: Resets speeds, torque, angle, smoothers, temperature (to the environment's), wear/damage coefficients and permanent damage state.
